Parameter escape / capture summary: for each parameter, whether its address is returned, stored in a global/heap/field, or passed to a capturing callee, plus the required referent lifetime (cases 3, 5).
Storage-lifetime lattice with a call-site check: callee-local, caller-local, by-value parameter, global/static, managed heap; reject a shorter-lived value stored in a longer-lived region.
Transitive composition through wrappers so to_view()/view()/file_borrow() and helper calls propagate the borrow/capture to the caller.
Tagged diagnostic (proposed [CPLUS-LIFETIME], optionally [CPLUS-BORROW]) that names the invalid operation and the owning local, counted as enforcement under --strict.
